categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extent of land, encumbrances, and other land-related particulars. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land registrations, property ownership, and land titles.
